panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
Support tickets opened in the 90 days to the data-through day, those still open, how many customers raised them, and the ask wanted by the most customers. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket, n360.v_top_asks  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 90 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT argMax(concat(ask, ' (', toString(customers), ' customers)'), tuple(customers, tickets)) FROM n360.v_top_asks) AS top
        SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, concat(concat(toString(countIf(opened > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 90)), if(countIf(opened > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 90) = 1, ' ticket', ' tickets')), ' in 90 days · ',
                      toString(countIf(status = 'open')), ' open · ',
                      concat(toString(uniqExactIf(account, opened > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 90)), if(uniqExactIf(account, opened > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 90) = 1, ' customer', ' customers')), ' raising them',
                      if(top = '', '', concat(' · most asked: ', top)))) AS sentence
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Tickets
panels.description:
Tickets opened in the 90 days to the data-through day. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the last 90 days

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if((SELECT count() FROM n360.ps_ticket) = 0, NULL, countIf(opened > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 90)) AS `opened in 90 days`
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Open
panels.description:
Tickets still open, whenever opened. The v2 tile marks P1; priority is not in the export yet. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if((SELECT count() FROM n360.ps_ticket) = 0, NULL, countIf(status = 'open')) AS `priority not exported yet`
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Customers raising them
panels.description:
Customers with a ticket opened in the last 90 days. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the last 90 days

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if((SELECT count() FROM n360.ps_ticket) = 0, NULL, uniqExactIf(account, opened > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 90)) AS `in 90 days`
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Asks from several customers
panels.description:
Asks tagged on tickets from 2 or more customers (n360.settings asks_several_customers; the v2 spec says 3 or more: open decision). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_top_asks  
**Filter:** none (every customer)  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if((SELECT count() FROM n360.ps_ticket) = 0, NULL, count()) AS `2 or more customers (proposed)`
        FROM n360.v_top_asks

panels.title: Asks, by number of customers
panels.description:
Each ask wanted by 2 or more customers, ranked by how many customers want it; open tickets are noted after the ask. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_top_asks, n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** none (every customer)  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(t.ask, if(o.n > 0, concat('  (', toString(o.n), ' open)'), '')) AS Ask, t.customers AS Customers
        FROM n360.v_top_asks AS t
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT ask, countIf(status = 'open') AS n FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE ask IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ask) AS o
               ON o.ask = t.ask
        ORDER BY Customers DESC, t.tickets DESC

panels.title: Tickets by product area
panels.description:
Tickets opened in the time range by product area. "Not tagged yet" is a real bucket, never a guess. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range (opened)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNull(product_area, 'Not tagged yet') AS Area, count() AS Tickets
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(opened) GROUP BY Area ORDER BY Tickets DESC

panels.title: Tickets opened per week, last 26 weeks
panels.description:
Tickets opened per week. The v2 page also shows tickets closed per week; the export has no closed date yet. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 26 weeks to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(opened)) AS time, count() AS Opened
        FROM n360.ps_ticket WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND opened > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 182 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Every ticket
panels.description:
Every ticket, open first then newest. Area and ask are tagged by hand ("Not tagged yet" until then). Filter a column from its header; export with the panel menu (Inspect > Data). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.ps_ticket  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** all tickets

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.ticket_id AS Ticket, ac.display_name AS Customer, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(t.opened)), ' ', formatDateTime(t.opened, '%b %Y')) AS Opened, t.title AS Title,
               t.product_area AS Area, t.ask AS Ask, t.status AS Status, t.account AS account
        FROM n360.ps_ticket AS t INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = t.account
        WHERE t.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY t.status = 'open' DESC, t.opened DESC
